item_name: Rothco Canvas Ammo Shoulder Bag With Military Patches
item_short_desc: Inspired by the classic military ammo bag, Rothco's canvas shoulder bag features a durable cotton canvas and military patches.
description: Rothco’s Canvas Ammo Shoulder Bag features two embroidered genuine military patches. The heavyweight cotton canvas ammo bag also features an adjustable shoulder strap for the most comfortable fit for any person and 2 outside hook and loop pockets for storing additional ammo. There is one main compartment with a storm flap and buckle strap closure to safely secure all items inside. Rothco’s Canvas Ammo Shoulder Bag measures 10” x 8” x 3 1/3”.
